verdict.rationale: LiveKit's pricing page claims "instant rollback to a previous agent deployment" on LiveKit Cloud, which implies deployment versions exist. Agents are plain Python/Node.js code, and the built-in test framework (pytest/Vitest behavioral tests, LLM-driven simulations, judges) offers a way to validate changes before release. Rollback is backed only by a one-line pricing-page mention, and versioning and review are inferred rather than documented. Missing for 10: documented deployment version history, a review or approval workflow for agent changes, versioning for no-code Agent Builder agents, in-depth rollback docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rollback.
